content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: Power Foundation of India has advertised a total of 04 vacancies for the Executive Trainee (Electrical) post. The number of vacancies is indicative and may be increased or decreased at the discretion of PFI.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institution with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree. Additionally, candidates must have appeared in GATE-2025 in Electrical Engineering (EE) and should possess a minimum 70% GATE-2025 score. The upper age limit shall be 27 years as on 01.10.2026. Candidates who have not appeared in GATE-2025 in Electrical Engineering (EE), or those holding GATE scores from any year other than GATE-2025, are not eligible. Candidates without the prescribed full-time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or those with less than 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA) cannot apply. content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates shall be appointed as Executive Trainee (Electrical) on a regular or full-time basis and shall undergo a structured one-year training programme. The proposed remuneration is tentatively Rs. 11 lakh per annum as per PFI policy, depending upon the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, and overall suitability. Trainees are also entitled to PF, gratuity, medical or insurance coverage, and other applicable benefits.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PFI Executive Trainee (Electrical)
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of the Power Foundation of India. Access the online application portal for recruitment of executive trainees. Upload a recent photograph and signature. Upload the GATE-2025 scorecard with the correct registration number. Upload the matriculation or 10th certificate as proof of date of birth. Upload the degree or provisional degree certificate along with marksheets of all semesters or years. Ensure that the information furnished in the application is correct and complete, then submit the application online on or before 03.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises two stages: Stage-I: Shortlisting based on GATE-2025 score: Candidates are shortlisted for the next stage based on their GATE-2025 score in Electrical Engineering (EE). Stage-II: Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview. The final merit is prepared with 75% weightage given to the GATE-2025 score and 25% to the Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the online application for PFI Executive Trainee (Electrical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online application is 03.11.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required GATE paper and score to be eligible for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have appeared in GATE-2025 in Electrical Engineering (EE) and possess a minimum 70% GATE-2025 score. GATE scores from any other year are not considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 27 years as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Executive Trainee position?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises Stage-I shortlisting based on the GATE-2025 score in Electrical Engineering (EE) followed by Stage-II personal interview, with a merit weightage of 75% for GATE score and 25% for the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a service bond applicable after selection?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates are required to execute a service bond of Rs. 2,00,000/- to serve PFI for at least 3 years after the successful completion of the one-year training.
